input.quote: (b) NON SOLICITATION. During the Term of this Agreement and during the three year period after the expiration or termination of this Agreement, the Licensee will not solicit any person employed by Licensor and/or its Affiliates to leave his or her employment with Licensor.
input.rationale: Article X(b) is the only non-solicit in the Agreement and it binds only the Licensee, runs for three years (36 months) after expiration or termination, and reaches every person employed by Licensor and/or its Affiliates rather than personnel involved in the services. That is walk-away territory on duration (>24 months) and scope (all Vendor personnel), and it fails three fallback elements (mutuality, involvement-based scope, 12-month cap). The retained "Solicit" definition already carves out general job advertisements and individuals who respond to advertisements or voluntarily initiate inquiries, and the restriction reaches only affirmative recruitment, so there is no no-hire ban. We therefore target the fallback with a single surgical edit to the operative sentence rather than deleting the clause outright, which would leave the Article XI injunctive-relief reference to "Non Solicitation of Licensor Employees" dangling.

proposal.summary: Narrow one-way 3-year non-solicit binding Licensee to a mutual 12-month restriction limited to personnel directly involved in the services
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The non-solicit binds only us, runs for three years post-termination and covers every Licensor and Affiliate employee, which is beyond our walk-away limits. We have made it mutual, limited it to personnel directly involved in services under this Agreement and cut the term to 12 months from the end of that involvement; the existing "Solicit" definition already preserves the general-advertising and unsolicited-inquiry carve-outs and imposes no hiring ban.

ops.oldText: During the Term of this Agreement and during the three year period after the expiration or termination of this Agreement, the Licensee will not solicit any person employed by Licensor and/or its Affiliates to leave his or her employment with Licensor.
ops.newText: During the Term of this Agreement and during the twelve (12) month period after the end of a person's involvement in services under this Agreement, neither party will solicit any person employed by the other party who is directly involved in performing services under this Agreement to leave his or her employment with that party.

mappings.element: The restriction covers only personnel directly involved in the Services.
The restriction lasts no longer than 12 months after the person's involvement ends.
General advertisements are excluded from the restriction.
mappings.quote: but shall not mean generally advertising job openings

mappings.element: Unsolicited approaches are excluded from the restriction.
mappings.quote: or any activities that constitute follow-up to individuals who respond to job opening advertisements or who voluntarily initiate employment inquiries.

mappings.element: The restriction does not prohibit hiring.
mappings.quote: the term "Solicit" means any affirmative recruitment specifically aimed at one or more individuals identified by name, title or affiliation
